preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, str) and len(c) == 1 for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every element in the output is a single-character string.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len({c for c in input if input.count(c) > 1})
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly the set of characters that repeat in the input, each appearing once.

postconditions.expression: all(c in input for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output must exist in the input string.
Every character in the output must repeat at least once in the input.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == next(c for c in input if input.count(c) > 1 and c not in return_value[:i]), i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The output preserves the order of first repetition of each character in the input.
